forum.title: How to Set PWM in CubeMx2/HA2?
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello again,

I can propose to look at the examples provided in CubeC5 package:

<https://github.com/STMicroelectronics/STM32CubeC5/tree/main/examples/hal/tim>

![mALLEm_0-1776862006340.png](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/c5dd0640-1039-4529-4fcc-6972fe26a3f4.png "mALLEm_0-1776862006340.png")

I don't think there is a step by step guide treating PWM for the moment. This knowledge base is about [How to use TIM with STM32CubeMX2](https://community.st.com/t5/stm32-mcus/how-to-use-tim-with-stm32cubemx2/ta-p/872788) but unfortunately treats the case of a basic time base.
